summary: From the October 28, 2025 patch, Red Hat Ansible Lightspeed can be deployed on new containerized AAP 2.6 installs or upgrades; it includes the Lightspeed intelligent assistant (chat in AAP, with MCP server integration as Technology Preview) and the Lightspeed coding assistant that works with IBM watsonx Code Assistant.
questions: Can I deploy Ansible Lightspeed on containerized AAP 2.6?
What are the two components of Red Hat Ansible Lightspeed?
Is the Lightspeed MCP server integration supported in production?
What does the Lightspeed coding assistant use?

answer_card.title: Ansible Lightspeed on containerized AAP 2.6
answer_card.answer_md:
Since the October 28, 2025 patch you can deploy Red Hat Ansible Lightspeed when you install or upgrade a **containerized** AAP 2.6. It has two parts:

- **Intelligent assistant**: AI chat embedded in AAP. Its integration with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server is **Technology Preview** (not for production SLAs).
- **Coding assistant**: generative AI with IBM watsonx Code Assistant for writing Ansible content.

See *Deploying Red Hat Ansible Lightspeed on containerized Ansible Automation Platform* in the containerized install guide.
